description: Base token facts — send a contract address, get name/symbol/decimals/supply read straight from the chain, the X/Twitter post counts that mention it, and an explicit list of what was NOT checked. Facts only: no score, no rating, no verdict. Facts only — this is not investment advice, a price target, or a buy/sell/hold signal. 404/free if the address isn't found; 503/free if the chain read is down. Costs $0.01 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.
name: token_verdict
